title: The new app and installer icons

steps.path: The Start menu, desktop shortcut, Dock and app list, once YouCoded is installed
steps.headline: Replace the app's icon with the robot from the youcoded.ai header?

labels.today: Today (left) and new (right), big and at real sizes

steps.changed: The dark terminal square with "YC" becomes the purple rounded square with the white robot, the same picture the website shows in its browser tab.
steps.notice: YouCoded looks like its website everywhere the icon appears. On a Mac the square sits inside a little empty margin, so it lines up with other apps in the Dock.
steps.risk: Anyone who already has YouCoded sees a different icon after updating and may look twice before recognising it.

steps.path: The downloaded installer, in Downloads and in search results (the Mac disk too)
steps.headline: Which installer icon should the download use?
steps.notice: Each is shown big and at the three sizes Windows really uses, on a light and a dark background.
steps.risk: All three keep the robot and the purple, so the installer still reads as YouCoded.

variants.label: Arrow badge
variants.summary: The app icon with a white arrow badge in the corner, like a notification dot. Closest to the app icon.
variants.risk: At the smallest size the badge shrinks to a dot, so it looks almost like the app itself.

variants.label: Arrow into tray
variants.summary: A small robot above a big download arrow and tray. Reads as a download at any size.
variants.risk: At the smallest size the robot is too small to make out.

variants.label: Arrow strip
variants.summary: The robot, with a darker band along the bottom carrying the arrow. A middle ground between the other two.
variants.risk: At the smallest size the arrow is hard to see.

steps.surface: The app's icon while it runs
steps.path: The taskbar or Dock icon while YouCoded is open, in each of the app's themes
steps.headline: While YouCoded is open, should its taskbar icon stay purple or take the colours of your theme?
steps.notice: Today the running app redraws its taskbar icon in your theme's colours. The built-in themes' colours are black, grey and white, so a themed robot is not purple in any of them.
steps.risk: Themes that bring their own icon keep it, whichever you pick.

variants.label: Always purple
variants.summary: The same purple robot in every theme, matching the installed icon and the website.

variants.label: Theme colours
variants.summary: The robot in each theme's own colours, the way the website's tab icon changes with its theme.
variants.risk: The icon changes between launching (purple) and running (your theme), which can look like two apps.

variants.label: Keep today's
variants.summary: Leave the running icon as the "YC" terminal square; only the installed icon changes.
variants.risk: The icon swaps from robot to letters the moment the app opens.
